journeyTitle: Trust The Thumb: 2,000 Miles Across America

liveStatus.currentNote: Due to a lack of preparation and unforeseen circumstances, our 2026 journey came to an end in Phoenix, Arizona. We are regrouping and starting the entire journey over from LA to Ohio in 2027!

waypoints.storySnippet: Official Start Line! Thumbs out on Santa Monica Blvd and kicked off the 2,000-mile journey across America.

waypoints.name: Kingman, AZ
waypoints.storySnippet: We woke up after sleeping in a tent a few hundred feet away from a gas station (the ONLY gas station within 60+ miles, anyways we wake up and walk towards the gas station to get to the street and begin hitch hiking when Kalaheo asked what we were doing and told us he thought it was cool but he is heading to california, then after 20 seconds he yelled over to us "Fck it ill take you guys to Kingman AZ (1+ hour drive in the OPPOSITE direction from where he is going) SHOUTOUT TO HIM HE IS AWESOME FOR THAT (oh yeah he bought us cold waters!)"

waypoints.name: Phoenix, AZ (2026 Final Stop)
waypoints.storySnippet: The end of the line for 2026. Due to a lack of preparation and unforeseen circumstances, our journey ended here in Phoenix, Arizona. We're regrouping and starting over from Los Angeles in 2027.

photos.caption: Waiting at the airport terminal for our flight
Quiet moment in the terminal, the end of the 2026 road
Wing view at dusk, see you in 2027
